title: Product is fine. Delivery was a mess.
text: Product is fine. Delivery was a mess.. Like I said, the product itself is fine. Mattress and box spring set to be delivered is a great deal. However, when checking out I was asked to specifically schedule a date and time for the item to be delivered since I had to sign for it, be home to let them in the house. I was planning to adjust my work schedule and had cleared that specific day/time to be home. A week before I got an email on Sunday night saying it would be delivered the next morning. Good thing I even checked my emails!! I had to scramble to rearrange my day to make the new delivery work. Why bother even asking for the specific date/time when you're not even going to follow it?? So frustrating!
